text: The figures show strong revenue growth (15.4% annual compounding and 10.3% YoY in Q2FY27) and improving EBITDA margin (up 6.6 points to –15.3%) alongside a solid ROE of 14.5% and zero debt, which back the bullish narrative. However, the weak cash conversion—five‑year operating cash flow only 0.23 times PAT—provides a bearish counterpoint.
